module.purpose: Provides a Redux middleware that detects illegal state mutations between and during dispatches in development, throwing errors to enforce immutability. Returns a no-op in production.
module.summary: This module implements a Redux middleware factory that safeguards state immutability. It exports a default immutability check, a tracker that recursively records object references, and a mutation detector that compares prior and current state trees. The middleware skips all work when NODE_ENV is production, but in development it measures execution time, tracks state before and after dispatch, and throws descriptive errors if mutations are found. It supports ignoring specific dot-path subtrees via regex or string match and includes a circular-reference-safe JSON stringifier for error messages.
module.businessContext: Critical dev-time guardrail for Redux applications; prevents subtle bugs from accidental state mutation. Failure yields silent data corruption in stores.

import type { Middleware } from 'redux'
import type { IgnoredPaths } from './serializableStateInvariantMiddleware'
import { getTimeMeasureUtils } from './utils'

units.name: isImmutableDefault

detail.name: isImmutableDefault
postconditions: Returns true if typeof value !== 'object' or value == null or Object.isFrozen(value) is true; otherwise returns false.
edgeCases: Primitive value (e.g., number, string, boolean) -> returns true
null or undefined -> returns true
Non-frozen object -> returns false
Frozen object -> returns true
detail.summary: Returns true if the given value is not an object, is null, or is a frozen object, thereby indicating it is immutable by default.

units.name: trackForMutations

detail.name: trackForMutations
detail.signature: export function trackForMutations(isImmutable: IsImmutableFunc, ignoredPaths: IgnoredPaths | undefined, obj: any)
preconditions: isImmutable must be a function accepting a value and returning a boolean indicating immutability
obj is the value to be tracked
ignoredPaths is either undefined or a paths specification to skip
postconditions: Returns an object containing a detectMutations method
The detectMutations method closes over the original arguments and tracked properties and delegates to detectMutations
edgeCases: ignoredPaths undefined is treated as no ignored paths
obj may be any type; tracking behavior depends on trackProperties implementation
detail.summary: Wraps an object with a mutation tracker that computes tracked properties upfront and exposes a detectMutations method to later check for mutations against the original object.

units.name: trackProperties

detail.name: trackProperties
detail.signature: function trackProperties(isImmutable: IsImmutableFunc, ignoredPaths: IgnoredPaths = [], obj: Record<string, any>, path: string = '', checkedObjects: Set<Record<string, any>> = new Set()): TrackedProperty
preconditions: isImmutable must be a callable function that reports whether a value is immutable
obj may be any value; non-objects are treated as leaves and not traversed
ignoredPaths entries must be either RegExp instances or string literals
checkedObjects must be a Set instance used to detect circular references
postconditions: Returns a TrackedProperty with its value set to obj
Children are populated only when obj is mutable and has not been previously seen
Each recursive child call uses an updated nested path
invariants: Circular references are prevented via checkedObjects; each mutable object is added exactly once
edgeCases: When obj is immutable, the returned TrackedProperty has only value set (no children)
When obj is already in checkedObjects, it is not re-tracked (no children)
When ignoredPaths is empty or a path matches an ignore entry, that key is skipped
When obj is null or not an object, the for-in loop does not execute and tracked.children remains undefined
stateMutations: checkedObjects: adds obj to the Set when obj is mutable and not already present
detail.summary: Builds a tree snapshot of an object's own enumerable properties, marking each node's value and recursively tracking mutable children while skipping immutable and ignored paths.

specLiterals.role: Constructs the nested property path for child property tracking

units.name: detectMutations

detail.name: detectMutations
detail.signature: function detectMutations(isImmutable: IsImmutableFunc, ignoredPaths: IgnoredPaths = [], trackedProperty: TrackedProperty, obj: any, sameParentRef: boolean = false, path: string = ''): { wasMutated: boolean; path?: string }
preconditions: trackedProperty must be defined with `value` and `children` properties
isImmutable must be a function returning boolean for a given value
ignoredPaths must be an array of string or RegExp
postconditions: If wasMutated true, includes path string of first mutation detected
If no mutation, returns { wasMutated: false } without path
invariants: Traversal visits all keys present in either trackedProperty.children or obj
Paths matching ignoredPaths (string equality or RegExp test) are skipped
edgeCases: sameParentRef true and prevObj !== obj and obj not NaN => returns mutated at current path immediately
isImmutable(prevObj) or isImmutable(obj) true => returns not mutated without deep check
ignoredPaths entry is RegExp and tests nestedPath true => key skipped
ignoredPaths entry equals nestedPath string => key skipped
obj is NaN with sameParentRef true => not treated as mutation (Number.isNaN check)
detail.summary: Recursively compares a previously tracked property snapshot against a current object to detect whether any nested property was mutated, respecting ignored paths. Returns whether a mutation occurred and the path to the first mutated property.

specTests.then: returns { wasMutated: false } because path ignored

detail.name: createImmutableStateInvariantMiddleware
preconditions: options is an object of type ImmutableStateInvariantMiddlewareOptions or undefined
postconditions: If process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production', returned middleware delegates to next without tracking
Otherwise returned middleware tracks state and throws Error on detected mutation

Mutation between dispatches throws Error with message containing 'A state mutation was detected between dispatches' and path
Mutation inside dispatch throws Error with message containing 'A state mutation was detected inside a dispatch' and stringified action
warnAfter option defaults to 32 if not provided

units.name: stringify

detail.name: stringify
detail.signature: function stringify(obj: any, serializer?: EntryProcessor, indent?: string | number, decycler?: EntryProcessor): string
preconditions: obj must be a value serializable by JSON.stringify
if provided, serializer and decycler must be callable EntryProcessor functions

detail.ioFormatSpec: Returns a JSON string conforming to the output of JSON.stringify with an optional indentation level and a custom replacer derived from getSerialize(serializer, decycler).
detail.summary: Serializes an object to a JSON string using a replacer function that supports optional custom serialization and cyclical reference handling.

units.name: getSerialize

detail.name: getSerialize
detail.signature: function getSerialize(serializer?: EntryProcessor, decycler?: EntryProcessor): EntryProcessor
preconditions: serializer and decycler parameters are either undefined or functions matching EntryProcessor signature
postconditions: Returns a function usable as a JSON replacer
If decycler is undefined, the returned function uses a built-in decycler that emits '[Circular ~]' or '[Circular ~.<path>]' for circular values
If serializer is null/undefined the returned function returns the (possibly decycled) value unchanged
invariants: Closure variables stack and keys track the current object traversal path across calls to the returned function
edgeCases: No decycler provided: root circular yields '[Circular ~]', nested circular yields '[Circular ~.<keys>]'
serializer undefined: value passed through after decycle check
value not previously seen in stack: no decycling applied
stateMutations: Mutates closure-local stack and keys arrays; they persist between top-level invocations of the returned function and are not reset
detail.summary: Returns a JSON replacer-style EntryProcessor that tracks object traversal to detect circular references, applying an optional custom serializer and a default decycler when none is supplied.

specLiterals.role: default decycler output for circular reference to root
